stemBlocks: The graph shows how body temperature of a human varies over a period of 60 minutes.
Which of the following could have caused the temperature change between X and Y?

1 Homeostasis causing more sweat production.
2 The temperature control centre in the brain causing hairs on the skin to stand up on end.
3 The temperature control centre in the brain causing less blood to flow near the skin's surface.
